text:
michelle: quick sync — from the INC-492 postmortem we have 4 cross-team actions left. dropping the distilled list here, pls confirm owner + due date. i’ll update the tracker once folks ack.

michelle: 1) investigate KV cache eviction spikes during high-concurrency (root cause suspicion: batching config). blockers: need perf traces from infra. (owner: ?; due: 2024-06-18)
michelle: 2) add fallback policy for model routing when gpus are saturated (policy + API changes). (owner: ?; due: 2024-06-21)
michelle: 3) backfill missing request-level traces for the affected window (sre + infra to coordinate). (owner: ?; due: 2024-06-17)
michelle: 4) audit canary rollout doc and add explicit rollback thresholds + runbook snippet. (owner: ?; due: 2024-06-19)

raj: I can take #1 (KV cache). need infra traces — @eli can you attach the perf logs / flamegraphs? target 6/18 works for me. :thumbsup:
eli: @raj yep, I’ll pull traces and a short timeline. attaching the command I used to collect: ```sudo perf record -a -g -o /tmp/perf.data && perf report -i /tmp/perf.data``` I’ll drop raw links in the tracker by EOD today. owner: raj; due: 2024-06-18
sophie: I’ll own #4 (canary rollouts). I want to propose we add a 1%->5%->25% ramp with latency and error thresholds, plus automated rollback on >1.5x p50 increase. I’ll sketch in the runbook and post PR. owner: sophie; due: 2024-06-19

eli: for #3 (traces) I need SRE buy-in for log retention — @michelle can you confirm we have permission to increase retention for that window? otherwise i’ll coordinate ephemeral forwarding to s3.
michelle: yes, go ahead with ephemeral S3 forward. please encrypt with the org KMS and label `inc-492`. thanks.

raj: for #2 (routing fallback) I can draft the policy but will need API changes from platform team. @sophie do you want to own the platform-side rollout or should I open a ticket and tag eng-platform? the core change is: when qps>threshold route to cheaper model-variant with equivalent tokenizer.

sophie: prefer eng-platform to drive the endpoint change. please open ticket `PLAT-874` and @mention ptl. I can help with acceptance tests. owner: eng-platform; due: 2024-06-21

michelle: i opened tracker row and added owners per above: #1 raj, #2 eng-platform, #3 eli, #4 sophie. link: https://redwood-internal/pm/inc-492/actions (please update with PR/ticket links)

raj: added PR #834 (draft) for kv cache logging. tagging @eng-ml for review. ETA for review request: tomorrow morning.
eli: uploaded flamegraphs and raw perf dump to the tracker. note: there's a spike at 2024-06-10T02:12Z, correlates with large batch jobs. I put the collection command in the doc.
incident-bot: reminder — INC-492 followups due soon. If owners do not update tracker within 48h, this thread will be pinged again.

sophie: raised a small dependency: the rollback automation needs the feature flag infra from eng-infra. I’ll file `INFRA-219` and link it.
raj: ack, will wait on that for full automation; manual fallback is fine short-term.

michelle: final ask — if you’re an owner, add the JIRA/PR link to the tracker and mark status: assigned / in-progress / blocked. I’ll run sweep on Friday 6/14 and escalate any blocked items.
eli: ack — marking #3 in-progress, linking S3 forwarding PR shortly.
sophie: ack — will open PR for runbook today and ping for reviews.
raj: ack — will request review and update status to in-progress.
michelle: great, thanks all. if nothing changes i’ll mark these owners in the RCA doc tomorrow morning. :white_check_mark:
